data.name: Change Shape
data.description: A bloodmarked skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a bloodmarked skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to Dexterity. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a bloodmarked skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage, +4 racial bonus on Perception checks, scent to a range of 30 feet, or treat falling damage as if the distance fallen were 20 feet less than it actually is. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
